description: The Myanmar Information Management Unit hosts a River Water Level Monitoring Dashboard, embedded from a Tableau Public workbook titled Myanmar River Water Level (current) by the Myanmar Geoinformatics Society. The workbook description says it visualises Myanmar river water levels from DMH daily data, and it has a main view, a main dashboard and river charts; the workbook metadata showed an update in 2026 and more than 8,700 views. The MIMU site also lists a dam water level monitoring dashboard. Coverage is DMH river gauges in Myanmar. Access is free online as an interactive dashboard, and MIMU products may be used free of charge with attribution. Caveats: the dashboard content is drawn in Tableau and could not be read as text from the cloud, so the stations and variables shown were not checked, and no download of the series was seen. Simulation uses: flood situational awareness and calibration context for river models in Myanmar. Related records: the MIMU village-level flood forecast dashboard (data-mimu-myanmar-village-flood-forecast-dashboard).
